poisson_events — DRIVE traffic op

• Data kinds: any → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.poisson_events(rate_fn: 'Callable', x_max: 'float', *, rate_max: 'float', seed, n_grid: 'int' = 2001) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetraffic; drivetraffic.poisson_events(rate_fn: 'Callable', x_max: 'float', *, rate_max: 'float', seed, n_grid: 'int' = 2001) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("poisson_events"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Draws 1 realization of an inhomogeneous Poisson process on [0, x_max] by thinning (Lewis & Shedler 1979) (an array of positions in ascending order).

Draw candidates from a homogeneous Poisson process of rate rate_max, and keep each candidate x with probability λ(x)/rate_max. The kept points form an inhomogeneous Poisson process of rate λ → count N ~ Poisson(Λ), Λ = ∫₀^{x_max} λ(x) dx (gate: over many trials, mean = variance = Λ, distribution of positions = λ/Λ). rate_fn is a function that takes a numpy array and returns rates of the same shape. Before drawing, λ ≤ rate_max is checked on an equally spaced grid of n_grid points, and it is also checked at the drawn candidates. If exceeded in either, ValueError (fail-closed. If the upper bound is not respected, thinning silently undercounts). seed is an int or an np.random.Generator.
